A Kerala girl. A Marwari boy. One rather lovely story ↓
North meets South.

It started in Udaipur.

He comes from Prayagraj. She comes from Kerala. They met in Udaipur. And somewhere between two very different homes, two very different personalities found their way to each other.

Two very different personalities.

A little Malayali.
A little Marwari.
A lot of love.

She is a dreamer, a planner, a coffee lover — and a little bossy.
He is sweet, calm, mature — and very much a tea person.

She likes having a plan. He has a way of making everything feel like it will work out. Somehow, they make a pretty good team.

The families

Somewhere between Kerala and Prayagraj, two families met.

She brought her world.
He brought his.

And now, their families get to experience a little of both — over a weekend in Kerala, surrounded by the people they love.
